method: Manual whole-file reading of RecoveryExFat.h/cpp,724 lines; pinned bytes verified. No disk access or recovery execution.
findings: Boot parser validates jump/name/revision, sector/cluster shifts, main boot checksum and extended signatures, device bounds and FAT/heap capacity. Requires one FAT and no active-secondary-FAT bit, so not all exFAT variants admitted. Backup boot-region recovery not implemented here.

Entry-set parser checks primary/stream/name types, restored InUse checksum, UTF16 names, size/initialized bounds and complete directory clusters. Deleted fragmented FAT-chain streams and extra benign secondary records are not supported recovery candidates; contiguous NoFatChain extents are supported.

Chain traversal is bounded by expected length or volume cluster count, detects cycles and demands exact FAT-chain length when provided. Directory traversal uses explicit stack and rejects reused/bitmap-owned/unallocated directory clusters. Memory still scales with cluster lists/visited set.

Allocation bitmap is read through its own possibly fragmented cluster chain; adjacent physical clusters are coalesced up to1MiB reads. Cached allocation pages are refreshed around source chunk reads. No throughput measurement established.

Validation rereads boot metadata, root/bitmap chains and allocation, then original entry offsets and exact entry-set bytes. Unlike FAT reader, this method does not validate the candidate containing-directory chain or membership of offsets in that directory; only aligned heap range is checked here. Runtime consequence unqualified.

Recovered bytes beyond ValidDataLength are explicitly zero-filled rather than exposing residual raw bytes. Initialized data is read only after/before fresh free-allocation checks, with final metadata validation around flush. Free allocation does not prove source data unchanged or historically correct.
Discovered callback fires before final Recycle Bin metadata name resolution. Partial scan candidates and later resolved names must be distinguished by consumers.
Source-volume/destination comparison is not performed in this RecoverFile implementation; policy remains to be checked in recovery dialog. No disk operations executed.
limits: No synthetic exFAT image parser tests, malformed entries, initialized-tail oracle, mutation/fault injection, disk reads or recovered writes performed.
No foreign production code adopted; native pHash investigation deferred. Global completed repository count remains147/500.
